text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 18, 2024) for 2278 Weston Road

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (June 18, 2024) for 2278 Weston Road, Folder Number 24 164748 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to January 5, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
